verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an official remote MCP server that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on a WorkOS workspace, reading and changing dashboard data such as organizations, connections, users and branding through the WorkOS API (workos-docs-15, workos-docs-9, workos-docs-44). A probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists (workos-probe-4). The AuthKit-for-your-own-MCP-server material is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented connection and auth setup steps and the tool list in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the server.
